latestaiagents--corrective-rag.function_description: Grades retrieved documents for relevance and refines retrieval to improve answer generation.
latestaiagents--corrective-rag.when_to_use: Use when initial retrieval returns irrelevant, ambiguous, or outdated documents.

latestaiagents--stack-trace-decoder.function_description: Parse stack trace text and extract error details and actionable insights.
latestaiagents--stack-trace-decoder.when_to_use: Use when you need to understand error origin, decode minified traces, or compare incidents.

lasmarois--managing-gitlab-mrs.function_description: Manages GitLab merge requests by creating, listing, and updating them via Go scripts.

latestaiagents--production-rag-checklist.function_description: Defines a production checklist and code snippets for building reliable, scalable RAG pipelines.

lattifai--omnicaptions-transcribe.function_description: Transcribe video or audio files and URLs into markdown captions with timestamps.

lattifai--omnicaptions-translate.function_description: Translates caption files (e.g., SRT, VTT, ASS) into a target language.

launchdarkly--create-skill.function_description: Creates a new LaunchDarkly SKILL.md file by guiding exploration, assessment, creation, and validation steps.

launchdarkly--launchdarkly-flag-discover.function_description: Analyzes LaunchDarkly feature flags to assess health and suggest cleanup recommendations.

launchdarkly--aiconfig-variations.function_description: Creates AI config variations to test model, prompt, or parameter changes.
launchdarkly--aiconfig-variations.when_to_use: When you need to test and optimize an existing AI configuration with controlled variations.

lauraflorentin--parallelization.function_description: Executes multiple independent tasks in parallel to reduce latency and increase output diversity.
lauraflorentin--parallelization.when_to_use: Use when tasks are independent and you need faster results, diverse options, or higher reliability.

launchdarkly--aiconfig-tools.function_description: Creates AI tool definitions and attaches them to AI config variations in LaunchDarkly.

launchdarkly--launchdarkly-flag-targetin.function_description: LaunchDarkly feature flag – guide to modify targeting rules, rollouts, and toggle state.

lauraflorentin--adaptation.function_description: It updates an AI agent's configuration by adapting its system prompt based on performance feedback.

lauraflorentin--reflection.function_description: Processes text drafts by critiquing and refining them to improve accuracy and quality.
lauraflorentin--reflection.when_to_use: Use when high accuracy, compliance, or iterative improvement of text output is required.

laurigates--accessibility-implementation.function_description: Implements WCAG and ARIA accessibility features in HTML web pages.
laurigates--accessibility-implementation.when_to_use: Use when creating or revising a web page to ensure WCAG compliance.

lauraflorentin--routing.function_description: Routes user queries to appropriate specialized agents based on intent classification.
lauraflorentin--routing.when_to_use: Use when you need to direct diverse user requests to specialized agents.

launchdarkly--launchdarkly-flag-cleanup.function_description: Removes a LaunchDarkly feature flag from the codebase while preserving production behavior.

laurigates--agents-analyze.function_description: Analyzes plugin collection to identify sub‑agent opportunities.
laurigates--agents-analyze.when_to_use: When you want to improve workflows by adding sub‑agents to isolate verbose output or enforce constraints.

lauraflorentin--planning.function_description: Generates a step-by-step plan for a textual goal and orchestrates its execution.

laurigates--binary-analysis.function_description: Extract printable text strings from binary files.

launchdarkly--aiconfig-update.function_description: AI config – update, archive, or delete configurations and their variations via API.

outfitter-dev--claude-skills.function_description: skill metadata file defines configuration for Claude Code skill

outfitter-dev--claude-rules.function_description: Creates and manages .claude/rules/ markdown files for project conventions.

outfitter-dev--claude-plugins.function_description: Manages Claude plugin lifecycle by scaffolding, validating, and distributing plugin manifests.
outfitter-dev--claude-plugins.when_to_use: Use when creating, testing, or publishing a new Claude Code plugin.
outfitter-dev--claude-plugins.limitations: Cannot reference files outside the plugin directory after installation.

outfitter-dev--codebase-recon.function_description: Analyzes source code files to gather evidence and produce confidence‑tracked findings.
outfitter-dev--codebase-recon.when_to_use: When exploring a codebase to understand architecture, patterns, performance, or security.
outfitter-dev--codebase-recon.limitations: Cannot draw conclusions without evidence and does not allow guessing or unsupported assumptions.

outfitter-dev--docs-audit.function_description: Audits markdown documentation files for correctness, links, completeness, and freshness, producing a structured report.
outfitter-dev--docs-audit.when_to_use: When documentation may be outdated or inconsistent with recent code changes.
outfitter-dev--docs-audit.limitations: Does not verify external URLs fully and assumes repository access to source files.

oschina--create-pr.function_description: Create a Gitee pull request by generating title and description from branch diff.
oschina--create-pr.when_to_use: When you need to open a Gitee pull request for recent branch changes.
oschina--create-pr.limitations: Cannot create a PR without repository details or a configured Gitee MCP server.

outfitter-dev--gitbutler-multi-agent.function_description: Manages git repository branches for multiple agents to work concurrently.
outfitter-dev--gitbutler-multi-agent.when_to_use: Use when several agents develop features or hand off work in the same repository simultaneously.
outfitter-dev--gitbutler-multi-agent.limitations: Does not support single-agent workflows or automated pull-request generation.

outfitter-dev--code-review.function_description: Performs a systematic checklist-based review of code files before commit, emitting findings and a summary.
outfitter-dev--code-review.when_to_use: Use for pre‑commit or pre‑merge code reviews requiring systematic quality verification.
outfitter-dev--code-review.limitations: Cannot handle quick sanity checks, trivial typo fixes, or formatting‑only changes.

outfitter-dev--context-management.function_description: Manage task objects to preserve state across context compaction.
outfitter-dev--context-management.when_to_use: Use for long-running, multi-step tasks nearing context limits or needing state across sessions.
outfitter-dev--context-management.limitations: Cannot retain reasoning or intermediate results that aren't saved in tasks.

outfitter-dev--debugging.function_description: Analyzes software bugs to determine root cause and verify a fix.
outfitter-dev--debugging.when_to_use: Use when bugs, errors, crashes, failing tests, or performance issues occur.
outfitter-dev--debugging.limitations: Cannot be used for obvious fixes, feature requests, or architecture planning without root cause investigation.

ouachitalabs--baml.function_description: Generates type-safe client code from .baml files for Python, TypeScript, Go, and Ruby.
ouachitalabs--baml.when_to_use: Use when building LLM applications that need structured, type-safe outputs.

outfitter-dev--maintain-tasks.function_description: Manages session task list to retain intent, dependencies, and agent assignments across context compaction.
outfitter-dev--maintain-tasks.when_to_use: When you need to keep work progress and assignments visible after context compaction.
outfitter-dev--maintain-tasks.limitations: Cannot replace external issue trackers for cross‑session, multi‑person project management.

outfitter-dev--find-root-causes.function_description: Analyzes system incidents to generate a formal root cause analysis report.
outfitter-dev--find-root-causes.when_to_use: Use when diagnosing system failures, outages, or incidents that require formal root cause documentation.
outfitter-dev--find-root-causes.limitations: Cannot handle known issues with documented fixes or simple configuration errors.

outfitter-dev--bun-dev.function_description: JavaScript/TypeScript files: run, build, test, and manage using Bun runtime commands.
outfitter-dev--bun-dev.when_to_use: Use when developing Bun applications, handling files, databases, servers, or scripts with Bun.
outfitter-dev--bun-dev.limitations: Cannot be used for Node.js‑only patterns or non‑Bun projects.

outfitter-dev--multi-agent-vcs.function_description: Manages git repository branches, staging, and commits for parallel AI subagents.
outfitter-dev--multi-agent-vcs.when_to_use: Use when dispatching parallel subagents to implement independent features requiring coordinated git commits.
outfitter-dev--multi-agent-vcs.limitations: Cannot handle git operations performed directly by subagents; assumes all git actions are orchestrator-controlled.

outfitter-dev--pathfinding.function_description: Operates on ambiguous project requirements and guides Q&A to produce a clear plan.
outfitter-dev--pathfinding.when_to_use: Use when requirements are ambiguous, incomplete, or need exploratory brainstorming.
outfitter-dev--pathfinding.limitations: Cannot handle time‑critical bugs, well‑defined tasks, or obvious questions.

outfitter-dev--claude-plugin-audit.function_description: Validates Claude plugin files and components against best‑practice standards.
outfitter-dev--claude-plugin-audit.limitations: Cannot modify files; it only audits existing plugin files.

outfitter-dev--codify.function_description: Converts pattern specifications into executable Claude components (skill, command, hook, or agent).
outfitter-dev--codify.when_to_use: When repeated behavior needs codifying or a user explicitly wants to capture a workflow.
outfitter-dev--codify.limitations: Cannot handle one‑off tasks, simple questions, or already well‑documented patterns.

outfitter-dev--patterns.function_description: Analyzes signals from conversations, code, or data to identify and document recurring patterns.
outfitter-dev--patterns.when_to_use: Use when recognizing recurring themes, best practices, workflows, or anti-patterns across multiple instances.
outfitter-dev--patterns.limitations: Cannot identify patterns from single occurrences or unvalidated hunches.

outfitter-dev--gitbutler-complete-branch.limitations: Cannot merge ongoing or incomplete branches, and does not handle stacked branches automatically.

outfitter-dev--performance.function_description: Analyzes code performance and applies targeted optimizations to improve latency and throughput.
outfitter-dev--performance.when_to_use: Use when code exhibits slow paths, memory leaks, high latency, or low throughput.
outfitter-dev--performance.limitations: Cannot optimize without prior measurement or when bottlenecks are guessed.

outfitter-dev--codex-config.function_description: Manages Codex CLI TOML configuration files, updating settings, profiles, and server definitions.

outfitter-dev--cli-development-guideline.function_description: Creates a CLI contract and help documentation for a command-line tool.
outfitter-dev--cli-development-guideline.when_to_use: Use when designing, implementing, or reviewing a command-line tool.

outfitter-dev--plugin-engineer.function_description: Transforms an external code repository into a Claude Code plugin.
outfitter-dev--plugin-engineer.when_to_use: Use when converting a CLI tool, library, or API repo into a Claude Code plugin.
outfitter-dev--plugin-engineer.limitations: Cannot create plugins from scratch, single-skill only, or modify existing Claude Code plugins.

outfitter-dev--hono-dev.function_description: Creates type-safe Hono REST API with route chaining, validation, and OpenAPI docs.
outfitter-dev--hono-dev.when_to_use: Use when building a type-safe Hono REST API, RPC client, or OpenAPI documentation.
outfitter-dev--hono-dev.limitations: Cannot be used for Bun runtime APIs or non-Hono frameworks such as Express or Fastify.

outfitter-dev--security.function_description: Analyzes source code to identify security vulnerabilities and generate remediation plan.
outfitter-dev--security.when_to_use: Invoke for security audits, code reviews, auth checks, input validation, crypto review, dependency analysis, or new feature modeling.
outfitter-dev--security.limitations: Cannot perform performance optimization, general code review, or implement new features.

outfitter-dev--research.function_description: Processes a research request to gather, evaluate, and synthesize information into a structured report.
outfitter-dev--research.when_to_use: Use for technology evaluation, documentation discovery, best‑practice research, or implementation guidance.
outfitter-dev--research.limitations: Cannot handle quick lookups or time‑critical debugging without full investigation.

outfitter-dev--software-craft.function_description: Provides engineering judgment to guide software design and development decisions.
outfitter-dev--software-craft.when_to_use: Use when making architectural or design decisions, evaluating trade‑offs, or assessing code refactoring needs.
outfitter-dev--software-craft.limitations: Cannot handle mechanical tasks or clear‑cut decisions requiring explicit instructions.

outfitter-dev--scenarios.function_description: Validates end‑to‑end behavior using .scratch test scripts and records successful patterns in scenarios.jsonl.
outfitter-dev--scenarios.when_to_use: Use when performing end‑to‑end feature validation, integration testing, or API contract verification.
outfitter-dev--scenarios.limitations: Cannot be used for unit tests, mock testing, performance or load benchmarking.

outfitter-dev--report-findings.function_description: Generates a structured report by synthesizing multi-source research findings with source attribution and confidence assessment.
outfitter-dev--report-findings.when_to_use: Use when you need to combine multiple sources into a credible, attributed findings report.
outfitter-dev--report-findings.limitations: Cannot produce reports from single-source summaries or unsupported opinions.

outfitter-dev--session-analysis.function_description: Analyzes chat messages to extract signals, detect behavioral patterns, and generate a summary report.
outfitter-dev--session-analysis.when_to_use: Use when a user asks for conversation analysis to identify frustration, success, preferences, and workflow evolution.
outfitter-dev--session-analysis.limitations: Cannot process real-time streams, generate content, or analyze single messages.

outfitter-dev--react-dev.function_description: TypeScript React files – guide typing components, hooks, and server actions.
outfitter-dev--react-dev.when_to_use: Use when building typed React components, generic components, event handlers, forms, refs, or using React 19 features.
outfitter-dev--react-dev.limitations: Cannot type non-React TypeScript or vanilla JavaScript React code.

outfitter-dev--simplify.function_description: Analyzes design documents to identify complexity smells and suggest simpler alternatives.
outfitter-dev--simplify.when_to_use: Use when planning features, evaluating solutions, or detecting premature optimization in non‑trivial proposals.
outfitter-dev--simplify.limitations: Cannot handle trivial tasks or already validated simple requirements.

outfitter-dev--skills-workflows.function_description: Manages markdown artifact files to orchestrate multi-step skill workflows.
outfitter-dev--skills-workflows.when_to_use: Use when building multi-skill pipelines that require deterministic state handoff between steps.
outfitter-dev--skills-workflows.limitations: Cannot handle single standalone skills; assumes workflow steps are defined with artifact markdown files.

outfitter-dev--skills-discovery.function_description: Searches and evaluates community SKILL.md files and plugins for quality and safety before installation.
outfitter-dev--skills-discovery.when_to_use: Use when you need to find existing skills or assess community plugins before installing.
outfitter-dev--skills-discovery.limitations: Cannot create new skills or validate your own skills.

outfitter-dev--stack-debug.function_description: Analyzes TypeScript Result objects to identify and fix common error handling mistakes.
outfitter-dev--stack-debug.when_to_use: Use when Result values return err instead of ok or type narrowing fails.

outfitter-dev--stack-patterns.when_to_use: Use when you need a testable, reusable, type‑safe function for CLI, HTTP, or MCP.

outfitter-dev--subagents.limitations: It does not execute code itself, only dispatches subagents to perform actions.

outfitter-dev--typescript-dev.function_description: TypeScript files: enforce strict typing and modern type‑safe patterns.
outfitter-dev--typescript-dev.when_to_use: When writing new TypeScript code and needing strict type safety, modern features, and validation.
outfitter-dev--typescript-dev.limitations: Cannot enforce type safety for non‑TypeScript code or runtime‑only logic.

outfitter-dev--stack-review.function_description: Audits TypeScript code to ensure @outfitter pattern compliance by scanning for anti-patterns and validating handlers.
outfitter-dev--stack-review.when_to_use: Use when you need to verify that a TypeScript codebase follows @outfitter error and logging standards.

outfitter-dev--stack-templates.function_description: Generates TypeScript component templates for Outfitter handlers, CLI commands, MCP tools, and daemons.

outfitter-dev--stack-audit.function_description: Scans a TypeScript codebase to identify Outfitter Stack adoption candidates and produce an audit report.
outfitter-dev--stack-audit.when_to_use: When you need to assess a project for Outfitter Stack adoption before planning migration.
outfitter-dev--stack-audit.limitations: Only scans TypeScript files; does not modify code or handle non‑TS languages.

outfitter-dev--skills-dev.function_description: Validates SKILL.md files against required structure and metadata rules.

outfitter-dev--stack-feedback.function_description: Creates GitHub issues in the outfitter-dev/outfitter repository for reported stack problems.
outfitter-dev--stack-feedback.when_to_use: Use this skill when you encounter bugs, missing features, unclear docs, pattern gaps, or ergonomic issues in the stack.

outfitter-dev--tdd.function_description: source code: execute test-driven development workflow
outfitter-dev--tdd.when_to_use: Use for new features, complex logic, bug fixes, or refactoring following TDD methodology.
outfitter-dev--tdd.limitations: Cannot be applied to exploratory coding, UI prototypes, static configs, or trivial glue code.

outlinedriven--assistant-ui.function_description: Configure and wire Assistant UI runtime components for integration and migration tasks.
outlinedriven--assistant-ui.when_to_use: Use when setting up, wiring, or debugging end‑to‑end Assistant UI integration.

outlinedriven--agno.function_description: Creates and manages Agno agents, teams, workflows, and AgentOS deployments.

outlinedriven--ag-ui.function_description: Implements AG-UI protocol integration between agent backend and UI client, ensuring correct event ordering and state sync.
outlinedriven--ag-ui.when_to_use: Use when the task is protocol-level integration between agent backend and UI client.

outfitter-dev--stack-architecture.function_description: Creates TypeScript handler signatures that define input, output, and error types for domain operations.

outfitter-dev--trails.function_description: Creates structured markdown handoff and log notes for session continuity.
outfitter-dev--trails.when_to_use: Use at session end, during research, or when preserving subagent context.

outfitter-dev--which-tool.function_description: Operates on generic files, selecting and executing the optimal CLI tool for the requested task.
outfitter-dev--which-tool.when_to_use: When the task is slow, tool missing, or user wants a more efficient solution.
outfitter-dev--which-tool.limitations: Cannot handle tasks with predetermined tool choices or trivial one-line commands.

outlinedriven--code-simplifier.function_description: Refines recently modified JavaScript/TypeScript code by applying project standards and simplifying its structure.
outlinedriven--code-simplifier.when_to_use: Use when code has been recently modified and needs standardization and simplification.

outlinedriven--mesop.function_description: Creates, debugs, and deploys Mesop Python web UI applications.

outsharp--google-news.function_description: Retrieves Google News RSS feeds for top stories, topic sections, or keyword searches.

outsharp--kalshi.function_description: Provides guidance for authenticating and using the Kalshi prediction market REST API.

outlinedriven--copilotkit.function_description: Configures CopilotKit provider and runtime to enable agent UI with shared state and interrupt handling.

outlitai--outlit-mcp.function_description: Query customer intelligence data using Outlit MCP tools.

outlinedriven--plan.function_description: Creates, reads, updates, lists, or deletes structured plan markdown files with YAML frontmatter.

outsharp--metaculus.function_description: Metaculus API – retrieve posts, forecasts, and download data as JSON.

outsharp--manifold.function_description: Retrieves prediction market data and user information using Manifold's REST API.
outsharp--manifold.when_to_use: When you need to programmatically access Manifold market or user details.

ovachiever--clerk-auth.when_to_use: Use this guide when updating Clerk or Next.js versions that introduce breaking authentication changes.

ovachiever--claude-agent-sdk.function_description: Validates agent response against a JSON schema to produce structured output.

ovachiever--elevenlabs-agents.function_description: Creates and manages ElevenLabs voice agents via SDKs, CLI, or API.

terraphim--security-audit.function_description: Analyzes Rust source code to identify security vulnerabilities and unsafe code issues.

udecode--create-agent-skills.limitations: Cannot execute side-effect actions unless disable-model-invocation is set to true.

udecode--figma-design-sync.function_description: Compare a web component implementation to a Figma design and adjust its HTML/CSS to match.
udecode--figma-design-sync.when_to_use: When you need to verify a component matches its Figma design and fix any differences.
udecode--figma-design-sync.limitations: Cannot run without a valid Figma URL and a reachable implementation URL.

udecode--design-implementation-reviewer.function_description: Compare live UI screenshots with Figma designs and generate a visual fidelity review.
udecode--design-implementation-reviewer.when_to_use: Use after implementing UI to verify it matches the Figma design.
udecode--design-implementation-reviewer.limitations: Cannot modify code; only provides discrepancy reports and suggested CSS fixes.

udecode--generate-command.function_description: Creates a new .claude/commands markdown file defining a custom Claude slash command.

udecode--install.function_description: Adds a postinstall script to package.json to auto-generate agent instructions.
udecode--install.when_to_use: When you need agent instructions generated automatically after installing dotai registry items.

udecode--frontend-design-frontend-design.function_description: Generate production‑grade HTML/CSS/JS (or React/Vue) code for a distinctive frontend interface.
udecode--frontend-design-frontend-design.when_to_use: Use when you need a custom, production‑ready UI built from specific design requirements.

udecode--git-history-analyzer.function_description: Analyzes code files in a git repository to trace their evolution and uncover historical patterns.
udecode--git-history-analyzer.when_to_use: Use when you need to understand a file’s past changes, contributors, or code pattern origins.

udecode--kieran-rails-reviewer.function_description: Rails code files review for conventions and quality

udecode--feature-video.function_description: Creates a feature demo video, uploads it, and embeds a link in a GitHub PR description.
udecode--feature-video.when_to_use: Use when you need a video walkthrough of a feature to include in a pull request.
udecode--feature-video.limitations: Cannot embed MP4 directly; requires a preview GIF and assumes ffmpeg, rclone, and agent-browser are installed.

udecode--gemini-imagegen.function_description: Generates or edits JPEG images via Gemini API based on text prompts and optional reference images.
udecode--gemini-imagegen.when_to_use: Use when you need to create or modify images from text prompts or reference pictures.
udecode--gemini-imagegen.limitations: Returns JPEG images only; cannot directly produce PNG without post-conversion.

udecode--julik-frontend-races-reviewer.function_description: Review Stimulus controller code to detect UI data races and timing issues.
udecode--julik-frontend-races-reviewer.when_to_use: After adding or modifying a Stimulus controller to check for UI race conditions.

udecode--dhh-rails-style.function_description: Analyzes Ruby on Rails code and suggests DHH-style conventions.
udecode--dhh-rails-style.when_to_use: Use when you need to align Ruby on Rails code with 37signals/DHH conventions.

udecode--frontend-design.function_description: Generate production‑grade HTML/CSS/JS (or React/Vue) code for a distinctive frontend interface.
udecode--frontend-design.when_to_use: Use when you need a custom, production‑ready web interface with a unique aesthetic.

udecode--learnings-researcher.function_description: Search markdown solution files and summarize relevant learnings for a given task.
udecode--learnings-researcher.when_to_use: Use it before beginning new development or debugging to surface existing documented solutions.

udecode--pr-comment-resolver.function_description: Resolves pull request review comments by implementing requested code changes.
udecode--pr-comment-resolver.when_to_use: Use when a reviewer leaves a comment requesting code modifications.
udecode--pr-comment-resolver.limitations: Cannot act on ambiguous comments without clarification.

udecode--lfg.function_description: Executes a video creation workflow by running sequential slash commands until the video is opened as a PR.
udecode--lfg.when_to_use: Use when you need to create and submit a video via the automated workflow pipeline.
udecode--lfg.limitations: Cannot run if required slash commands are unavailable or if the video cannot be opened as a PR.

udecode--learn.function_description: Creates a .mdc skill file by extracting reusable knowledge from a work session.
udecode--learn.when_to_use: Use when you encounter non‑obvious solutions, project‑specific patterns, tool integration knowledge, error resolutions, or workflow optimizations.

udecode--react.function_description: Applies React patterns and optimizations to .tsx and globals.css files.

udecode--pattern-recognition-specialist.function_description: Analyzes a codebase to detect design patterns, anti-patterns, naming issues, duplication, and architectural violations.
udecode--pattern-recognition-specialist.when_to_use: Use this skill when you need to review a codebase for design patterns, anti-patterns, and overall code quality.

udecode--lint.function_description: Runs lint checks and auto-fixes on Ruby and ERB files, and scans for security issues.
udecode--lint.when_to_use: When code changes include Ruby or ERB files needing linting or security review.

udecode--pr.function_description: GitHub pull request automation that creates, drafts, and reviews pull requests.
udecode--pr.when_to_use: When a user asks to create, draft, or review a pull request.

udecode--report-bug.function_description: Collects bug details for the compound-engineering plugin and creates a GitHub issue.
udecode--report-bug.when_to_use: Use when you encounter a problem with the compound-engineering plugin and need to report it.
udecode--report-bug.limitations: Cannot create the issue if the GitHub CLI is not authenticated.

udecode--performance-oracle.function_description: Analyzes source code to identify performance bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.
udecode--performance-oracle.when_to_use: Use when you need to evaluate code for performance bottlenecks and scalability.

udecode--security-sentinel.function_description: Scans source code files for security vulnerabilities and compliance issues.
udecode--security-sentinel.when_to_use: When you need to verify that new API endpoints or modules are free of security vulnerabilities before deployment.

udecode--resolve-parallel.function_description: Resolve TODO comments in source code files using parallel processing.

udecode--resolve-todo-parallel.function_description: Processes markdown TODO files to resolve and remove each comment in parallel.
udecode--resolve-todo-parallel.when_to_use: Use when multiple unresolved TODO comments exist in the /todos markdown files.
udecode--resolve-todo-parallel.limitations: Cannot resolve TODOs that suggest deleting or ignoring files in docs/plans or docs/solutions.

udecode--kieran-typescript-reviewer.function_description: Reviews TypeScript source files to enforce strict type safety and code quality standards.
udecode--kieran-typescript-reviewer.when_to_use: When you have added or modified TypeScript code and need a strict quality check.

udecode--orchestrating-swarms.function_description: Manages JSON team and task files to spawn and coordinate Claude agents.
udecode--orchestrating-swarms.when_to_use: When you need multiple Claude agents to work together on a shared task list.

udecode--setup.function_description: Creates or updates compound-engineering.local.md with configured review agents.

udecode--resolve-pr-parallel.function_description: Resolves unresolved pull request review comments by spawning parallel agents.
udecode--resolve-pr-parallel.when_to_use: When a pull request has unresolved review comments that need to be addressed quickly.
udecode--resolve-pr-parallel.limitations: Cannot resolve outdated or already resolved comments; assumes comments are unresolved and non-outdated.

udecode--reproduce-bug.function_description: Analyzes a GitHub issue to reproduce the bug and collect logs, screenshots, and code references.
udecode--reproduce-bug.when_to_use: When a reported GitHub issue lacks a reproducible test case or needs visual verification.

udecode--repo-research-analyst.function_description: Analyzes a code repository to extract architecture, issue conventions, documentation, templates, and implementation patterns.
udecode--repo-research-analyst.when_to_use: Use when you need to understand a repository’s structure, conventions, and implementation patterns.

udecode--sync-testing-skill.function_description: Scans TypeScript test files and updates testing.mdc with new test patterns.
udecode--sync-testing-skill.limitations: Cannot add theoretical examples; only actual codebase patterns are processed.

udecode--slfg.function_description: Operates on workflow definitions to orchestrate planning, execution, review, and video documentation steps.
udecode--slfg.when_to_use: Use when you need an automated end‑to‑end workflow with planning, execution, review, and video output.
udecode--slfg.limitations: Cannot run without required sub‑skills and assumes they are installed and functional.

udecode--tdd.function_description: Guides developers to write tests for software code using test‑driven development practices.
udecode--tdd.when_to_use: Use when you need to verify code behavior through public interfaces before implementation.

udecode--trace.function_description: Analyze source code call stack to trace the original bug trigger.
udecode--trace.when_to_use: Use when an error appears deep in the execution stack and the origin is unclear.

udecode--schema-drift-detector.function_description: Analyzes schema.rb to detect drift by comparing changes against PR migrations.
udecode--schema-drift-detector.when_to_use: When a pull request modifies schema.rb and you need to ensure only PR migrations caused the changes.
udecode--schema-drift-detector.limitations: Cannot resolve drift if migrations are missing or schema.rb is not version‑controlled.

udecode--test-browser.function_description: Runs end-to-end browser tests on web pages affected by a PR or branch change.
udecode--test-browser.when_to_use: When you need to verify UI changes on pages modified by a PR or branch.
udecode--test-browser.limitations: Cannot test pages if the local development server is not running.

udecode--test-xcode.function_description: Builds, installs, and tests an iOS app on a simulator, capturing screenshots and logs.
udecode--test-xcode.when_to_use: When you need to verify an iOS app’s behavior on a simulator after code changes.
udecode--test-xcode.limitations: Cannot run tests on physical devices; requires XcodeBuildMCP and a configured iOS simulator.

udecode--translate.function_description: Translate updated sections of an MDX file from English to Chinese while preserving all formatting.
udecode--translate.when_to_use: Use when the English MDX source has changed and the Chinese version needs syncing.
udecode--translate.limitations: It does not translate code inside code blocks or component names.

udecode--workflows-compound.function_description: Creates a markdown solution document in docs/solutions/ from recent problem resolution.
udecode--workflows-compound.when_to_use: Use after a problem has been solved to capture the fix.
udecode--workflows-compound.limitations: Cannot run if the problem is unsolved, unverified, or trivial.

udecode--triage.function_description: process markdown todo files in todos/ directory to triage and update their status
udecode--triage.when_to_use: use when reviewing code review, security, or performance findings to decide if they become tracked todos
udecode--triage.limitations: cannot modify source code; works only on markdown files following the pending‑ready naming convention

udecode--update-app-design.function_description: Updates an application design markdown document to reflect current codebase and priorities.
udecode--update-app-design.when_to_use: When the application design document is outdated compared to the current codebase.
udecode--update-app-design.limitations: Cannot generate a design document without an existing baseline file.

udecode--writing-changesets.function_description: Creates properly formatted .changeset markdown files documenting package changes.
udecode--writing-changesets.when_to_use: Use when creating .changeset markdown files to document package changes for releases.
udecode--writing-changesets.limitations: Cannot be used for internal documentation, commit messages, or PR descriptions.

udecode--update-tech-stack.function_description: Update a markdown tech stack document to reflect current dependencies and infrastructure changes.

umbraco--package-script-writer.function_description: Generate and run Umbraco CMS installation scripts using the psw CLI.
umbraco--package-script-writer.when_to_use: Use when provisioning a new Umbraco site with default or custom packages.
umbraco--package-script-writer.limitations: Cannot process passwords containing escapable characters and requires the psw CLI to be installed.

uhyo--funstack-static-knowledge.function_description: Generates static HTML, JavaScript, and CSS files for a React SPA using FUNSTACK Static.
uhyo--funstack-static-knowledge.when_to_use: Use when deploying a React single-page application as static files without a server runtime.
uhyo--funstack-static-knowledge.limitations: Cannot use Server Actions ('use server') because no server runtime is deployed.

udecode--workflows-work.function_description: Executes a work plan document by breaking it into tasks, implementing, testing, and committing changes.
udecode--workflows-work.when_to_use: Use when you have a detailed plan or specification that needs systematic implementation.
udecode--workflows-work.limitations: Cannot proceed without user clarification on ambiguous or unclear plan items.

udecode--workflows-plan.function_description: Creates a markdown issue plan from a feature, bug, or improvement description.
udecode--workflows-plan.when_to_use: Use when you need a structured markdown issue plan for a feature, bug, or improvement.
udecode--workflows-plan.limitations: Cannot create a plan without a non‑empty feature description or relevant brainstorm input.

umbraco--umbraco-bundle.function_description: Creates a JavaScript/TypeScript bundle that groups multiple Umbraco extension manifests.
umbraco--umbraco-bundle.when_to_use: Use when you need to combine multiple Umbraco extension manifests into one JavaScript/TypeScript bundle.

umbraco--umbraco-auth-provider.function_description: Creates Umbraco auth provider manifest and optional custom login button.
umbraco--umbraco-auth-provider.when_to_use: Use when adding an external OAuth login button to the Umbraco backoffice.
umbraco--umbraco-auth-provider.limitations: Cannot configure backend authentication; assumes backend provider is already set up.

umbraco--umbraco-add-extension-reference.function_description: Adds a ProjectReference for a new Umbraco extension into the main Umbraco .csproj file.
umbraco--umbraco-add-extension-reference.when_to_use: After creating or moving a new Umbraco backoffice extension project.
umbraco--umbraco-add-extension-reference.limitations: Assumes the main project contains a Umbraco.Cms PackageReference.

umbraco--umbraco-collection.function_description: Creates a custom Umbraco collection to display and manage entity lists with views, filtering, and actions.
umbraco--umbraco-collection.when_to_use: When you need a backoffice UI to browse, filter, and act on a set of entities.
umbraco--umbraco-collection.limitations: Assumes a REST API endpoint provides items; cannot function without a data source implementation.

umbraco--umbraco-conditions.function_description: Add conditions to a manifest to control extension visibility in Umbraco backoffice.
umbraco--umbraco-conditions.when_to_use: Use when you need to show or hide a backoffice extension based on section, workspace, or user context.

umbraco--umbraco-collection-view.function_description: Creates a TypeScript manifest and view element to define a custom Umbraco collection view.
umbraco--umbraco-collection-view.when_to_use: When you need a custom visual layout for an Umbraco collection.

umbraco--umbraco-context-api.function_description: Provides or consumes Umbraco context within TypeScript LitElement components.
umbraco--umbraco-context-api.when_to_use: Use when a component needs to access shared Umbraco services like notifications or user data.

umbraco--umbraco-collection-action.function_description: Creates a collection action button that executes code or navigates for an Umbraco collection.
umbraco--umbraco-collection-action.when_to_use: When you need a toolbar button to perform a bulk operation on an Umbraco collection.
umbraco--umbraco-collection-action.limitations: Cannot operate on individual items; only collection-level actions are supported.

umbraco--umbraco-block-editor-custom-vie.function_description: Creates a custom block editor view for Umbraco block list, grid, or RTE editors.
umbraco--umbraco-block-editor-custom-vie.when_to_use: Use when you need a custom visual representation for blocks in list, grid, or RTE editors.

umbraco--umbraco-current-user-action.function_description: Creates a manifest and TypeScript class to register a backoffice current user action.
umbraco--umbraco-current-user-action.when_to_use: Use when you need to add a custom current user menu action in Umbraco backoffice.
umbraco--umbraco-current-user-action.limitations: Assumes an Umbraco backoffice environment with TypeScript support.

umbraco--umbraco-dynamic-root.function_description: Creates TypeScript manifest files defining Umbraco dynamic root origins and query steps.
umbraco--umbraco-dynamic-root.when_to_use: Use when a content picker needs a dynamic starting point based on context.
umbraco--umbraco-dynamic-root.limitations: Requires corresponding C# backend implementations; does not generate server-side logic.

umbraco--umbraco-e2e-testing.function_description: Executes end-to-end tests on Umbraco backoffice extensions using Playwright testhelpers.
umbraco--umbraco-e2e-testing.when_to_use: Use when you need to validate complete user workflows in a real Umbraco instance.
umbraco--umbraco-e2e-testing.limitations: Cannot test custom UI elements with testhelpers; raw Playwright required for custom extensions.

umbraco--umbraco-backoffice.function_description: Provides complete working blueprints for Umbraco backoffice extensions.
umbraco--umbraco-backoffice.when_to_use: When you need a new Umbraco backoffice extension or section.

umbraco--umbraco-entity-create-option-ac.function_description: Adds a custom create option for Umbraco entities via a manifest and action class.
umbraco--umbraco-entity-create-option-ac.when_to_use: When you need a custom creation path for an Umbraco entity.

umbraco--umbraco-controllers.function_description: Creates TypeScript controller classes that manage host element lifecycle and side‑effects.

umbraco--umbraco-extension-template.function_description: Creates a new Umbraco backoffice extension project using a .NET template.
umbraco--umbraco-extension-template.when_to_use: Use when you need to scaffold a fresh Umbraco backoffice extension.

umbraco--umbraco-entity-actions.function_description: Executes a custom action on an Umbraco entity (e.g., document, media) from the backoffice.

umbraco--umbraco-entry-point.function_description: Executes JavaScript entry point to initialize Umbraco backoffice and register extensions.
umbraco--umbraco-entry-point.when_to_use: When you need to run custom code on backoffice startup, such as loading libraries or registering UI extensions.
umbraco--umbraco-entry-point.limitations: Only works within Umbraco backoffice; cannot run outside that environment.

udecode--architecture-strategist.function_description: Analyzes source code changes for architectural compliance
udecode--architecture-strategist.when_to_use: Use when reviewing code changes or adding new services to ensure architectural compliance

umbraco--umbraco-entity-bulk-actions.function_description: Applies a bulk action to selected Umbraco entities in a collection.
umbraco--umbraco-entity-bulk-actions.when_to_use: When you need to process or modify multiple selected items in an Umbraco collection at once.
umbraco--umbraco-entity-bulk-actions.limitations: It cannot operate without a selection of entity IDs or a repository providing the required methods.

umbraco--umbraco-example-generator.function_description: Generates testable Umbraco backoffice extensions from TypeScript files.
umbraco--umbraco-example-generator.when_to_use: Use when creating demonstration or testable Umbraco backoffice extensions quickly.
umbraco--umbraco-example-generator.limitations: Only works within a cloned Umbraco source development environment.

umbraco--umbraco-icons.function_description: Registers custom SVG icons for Umbraco backoffice via manifest.
umbraco--umbraco-icons.when_to_use: When you need custom icons in Umbraco backoffice extensions.
umbraco--umbraco-icons.limitations: Cannot register non‑SVG icons; requires manifest registration and supported Umbraco version.

umbraco--umbraco-extension-registry.function_description: Manages Umbraco backoffice UI extensions by registering, excluding, replacing, or unregistering them at runtime.
umbraco--umbraco-extension-registry.when_to_use: Use when you need to add, hide, replace, or remove backoffice UI features at runtime.
umbraco--umbraco-extension-registry.limitations: Only works for runtime extensions; static package-defined extensions cannot be altered.

umbraco--umbraco-global-context.function_description: Creates a TypeScript global context for sharing state across the Umbraco backoffice.
umbraco--umbraco-global-context.when_to_use: When you need to share state or services across the entire Umbraco backoffice session.
umbraco--umbraco-global-context.limitations: Do not use if a more specific scoped context can satisfy the requirement.

umbraco--umbraco-granular-user-permissio.function_description: Creates TypeScript manifest and element to define granular user permissions for specific Umbraco entity types.
umbraco--umbraco-granular-user-permissio.when_to_use: When you need custom per-entity permission controls in Umbraco.

umbraco--umbraco-kinds.function_description: Creates or registers an Umbraco Kind manifest to provide default properties for extensions.
umbraco--umbraco-kinds.when_to_use: Use this skill when you need a reusable Kind to share default properties across multiple Umbraco extensions.
umbraco--umbraco-kinds.limitations: The skill only generates manifest code; it does not verify compatibility with existing Umbraco installations.

umbraco--umbraco-health-check.function_description: Creates a custom Umbraco health check manifest and context implementation.
umbraco--umbraco-health-check.when_to_use: Use when you need to add custom diagnostics to the Umbraco Health Check dashboard.
umbraco--umbraco-health-check.limitations: Cannot generate checks without access to Umbraco back‑office APIs or appropriate project setup.

umbraco--umbraco-mfa-login-provider.function_description: Creates an Umbraco manifest and UI element to configure a two‑factor authentication login provider.
umbraco--umbraco-mfa-login-provider.when_to_use: When you need to add a custom two‑factor authentication UI to Umbraco.
umbraco--umbraco-mfa-login-provider.limitations: Does not implement the backend ITwoFactorProvider logic; assumes it is configured elsewhere.

umbraco--umbraco-dashboard.function_description: Creates a custom Umbraco dashboard by generating its manifest and JavaScript implementation.
umbraco--umbraco-dashboard.when_to_use: When you need a new backoffice panel to display custom information in Umbraco.

umbraco--umbraco-mocked-backoffice.function_description: Runs Umbraco backoffice UI with all API calls mocked, no .NET backend required.
umbraco--umbraco-mocked-backoffice.when_to_use: Use to visually test extensions without deploying a backend.
umbraco--umbraco-mocked-backoffice.limitations: Only works when run from the Umbraco-CMS source repository; external extensions not yet supported.

umbraco--umbraco-menu.function_description: Creates Umbraco menu or menuItem manifest files to add or extend backoffice menus.
umbraco--umbraco-menu.when_to_use: When you need to add a new backoffice menu or extend an existing Umbraco menu.
umbraco--umbraco-menu.limitations: Assumes you have access to Umbraco backoffice and appropriate manifest registration.

umbraco--umbraco-header-apps.function_description: Creates Umbraco header app manifest and optional element for a link or interactive button.
umbraco--umbraco-header-apps.when_to_use: When you need a globally accessible link or custom button in the Umbraco backoffice.

umbraco--umbraco-file-upload-preview.function_description: Renders custom preview for uploaded files in Umbraco based on their MIME types.
umbraco--umbraco-file-upload-preview.when_to_use: Use when you need visual previews of files during upload in Umbraco.

umbraco--umbraco-package-view.function_description: Creates a Umbraco package view manifest and element to display a custom configuration panel.
umbraco--umbraco-package-view.when_to_use: Use when you need a custom UI panel for an installed Umbraco package.
umbraco--umbraco-package-view.limitations: Cannot generate views for packages without matching name in umbraco-package.json.

umbraco--umbraco-manifest-picker.function_description: Select an Umbraco extension manifest using the umb-input-manifest component.
umbraco--umbraco-manifest-picker.when_to_use: Use when creating a configuration screen that must reference another Umbraco extension.
umbraco--umbraco-manifest-picker.limitations: Cannot operate if the extension registry is unavailable or not loaded.

udecode--ankane-readme-writer.function_description: Generate or reformat a Ruby gem README following the Ankane template.
udecode--ankane-readme-writer.when_to_use: When you need a new or updated Ruby gem README that follows Ankane style.
udecode--ankane-readme-writer.limitations: Cannot generate READMEs for non‑Ruby gems or non‑Ankane formats.

umbraco--umbraco-menu-items.function_description: Creates Umbraco backoffice menu item manifests and optional custom elements.

umbraco--umbraco-openapi-client.function_description: Generates a TypeScript OpenAPI client for Umbraco backoffice APIs and configures bearer token authentication.
umbraco--umbraco-openapi-client.when_to_use: When calling custom Umbraco backoffice APIs from the frontend or custom UI components.
umbraco--umbraco-openapi-client.limitations: Raw fetch calls cannot authenticate; the skill requires using the generated OpenAPI client.

umbraco--umbraco-playwright-testhelpers.function_description: Provides Playwright API and UI helpers for testing Umbraco backoffice.
umbraco--umbraco-playwright-testhelpers.when_to_use: Use when writing end‑to‑end tests for an Umbraco backoffice.

umbraco--umbraco-localization.function_description: Retrieves localized strings from JavaScript localization files for Umbraco components.

umbraco--umbraco-modals.function_description: Generates Umbraco modal component files (token, element, manifest) for custom dialogs or sidebars.
umbraco--umbraco-modals.when_to_use: Use when you need to add a custom dialog or sidebar modal to the Umbraco backoffice.

umbraco--umbraco-property-editor-ui.function_description: Creates a TypeScript property editor UI and manifest for Umbraco backoffice content editing.
umbraco--umbraco-property-editor-ui.when_to_use: When you need a custom backoffice input component for Umbraco.
umbraco--umbraco-property-editor-ui.limitations: Cannot work with custom schema without a corresponding server‑side C# DataEditor.

umbraco--umbraco-preview-app-provider.function_description: Creates a preview app manifest and element to add custom functionality to Umbraco preview menu.
umbraco--umbraco-preview-app-provider.when_to_use: Use when editors preview content and require custom preview functionality in the menu.

umbraco--umbraco-property-editor-schema.function_description: Generates an Umbraco property editor schema to configure data validation and storage.
umbraco--umbraco-property-editor-schema.when_to_use: Use when you need custom server-side validation, data transformation, or complex data structures.
umbraco--umbraco-property-editor-schema.limitations: Does not create the property editor UI; only defines server-side schema.

umbraco--umbraco-property-action.function_description: Adds a custom button to Umbraco property editors to perform user-defined actions.
umbraco--umbraco-property-action.when_to_use: Use when you need a button beside a property label to trigger a custom action.

umbraco--umbraco-quickstart.function_description: Sets up an Umbraco project and extension, creating files and configuration for development.
umbraco--umbraco-quickstart.when_to_use: Use when you need to create a new Umbraco site and extension and prepare for planning and building.
umbraco--umbraco-quickstart.limitations: Cannot build code before plan mode is completed and assumes local environment with required tools installed.

umbraco--umbraco-review-checks.function_description: Runs review checks on Umbraco extension files.
umbraco--umbraco-review-checks.when_to_use: Use when reviewing an Umbraco extension to validate code quality, architecture, and UI patterns.
umbraco--umbraco-review-checks.limitations: Cannot automatically fix checks marked as No or Partial.

umbraco--umbraco-property-value-preset.function_description: Provides default values for Umbraco property editors by implementing a property value preset API.
umbraco--umbraco-property-value-preset.when_to_use: Use when creating new content that needs default values for property editors.

umbraco--umbraco-routing.function_description: Creates Umbraco backoffice routing definitions for sections, dashboards, or custom elements.

umbraco--umbraco-picker-data-source.function_description: Creates an Umbraco picker data source that supplies items for content picker editors.
